The '''male shanjaru''' was the last male member of [[shanjaru]], a species that was driven nearly to extinction at the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. [[Drooga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] possessed the last [[female shanjaru]] and wished to complete the set in order to serve them as part of his feast. [[Risha Drayen]] obtained the male shanjaru and traded him to Drooga in exchange for a prototype engine.

==Behind the scenes==
The male shanjaru appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Smuggler class story.
